~34pt rows, tinted type-icon + 13pt filename + trailing 12pt secondary timestamp, inset ~1pt hairline dividers, tracked-uppercase group subheader

signature_moves: The vitrine literalized: one all-translucent floating pane with content rendered directly on the glass (tints to wallpaper) - the app's entire character and its entire contrast risk in one decision

Staged preview-stack collage - a folder's real contents fanned as a physical pile with depth, rotation, drop shadows and a playing video (scrubber+timecodes); the one focal element, boldness budget spent here
Honest proportional data-viz - Types bar widths equal true item counts; three identity hues used consistently across bar, legend and list icons, distinct from any app accent
defects: Contrast Dilution / glass-in-content - file list, dividers and secondary text on translucent glass instead of an opaque content surface; legibility becomes wallpaper-dependent
UI contrast failure - row hairline dividers ~#F2F8FF on ~#DFF3FF glass, far below 3:1
Text contrast - secondary timestamps/metadata over lighter glass regions below 4.5:1
Target Starvation (borderline) - close/dismiss circles ~16-18pt under the 24px floor unless hit-area padded (unconfirmable from static render)

aesthetic.direction: glass-utility / Liquid-Glass single-panel - restrained system-native info panel wearing a full translucent refractive skin, with one theatrical photo-stack focal moment

psychology: Aesthetic-Usability Effect - glass + staged photo-stack manufacture a strong ~50ms first impression / quality halo that buys forgiveness for contrast costs on first contact but not for daily legibility
Von Restorff - the fanned preview-stack is the one different thing, so the eye lands there first (single focal object)

Jakob's Law - mirrors Quick Look conventions (close top-left, share top-right, space-bar-preview archetype); but translucency undercuts the processing-fluency users expect from a crisp system info panel
Hierarchy via de-emphasis - metadata, counts and timestamps pushed to secondary gray so filenames and folder title anchor
notes: Only ONE live app surface exists - the macapp.supply cover.webp is a marketing composite that embeds the real folder-preview panel over a blue macOS wallpaper; gallery is empty. Single surface -> all tokens (inferred), none promotable to canon. Glass tint (#DFF3FF) is wallpaper-driven, so the true neutral panel material is under-determined; request a dark-mode and a neutral-wallpaper capture. A Liquid Glass app icon (icon.jpg: frosted folder + photo) also exists but was NOT digested - this pass is Workflow A (UI) only; flag for Workflow B. Composite reads ~1x logical (panel ~878x580 matches kit example scale) so px approx pt was assumed - treat all sizes as estimated ranges. No dark mode, no selection state, no forms/settings surfaces seen.
